data.content_ref: inline:The isolated 14ab0ddd3b5e contradicts SRC_003 by resolving the underdetermination that SRC_003 identifies: it supplies the covering principle (constant unit rate) that SRC_003 argues is missing from the problem statement. The contradiction is that 14ab0ddd3b5e treats the linear model as domain-entailed, while SRC_003 treats it as empirically assumed. This is REFUTED IF SRC_003's underdetermination argument is compatible with 14ab0ddd3b5e (i.e., if 14ab0ddd3b5e explicitly acknowledges the underdetermination as a caveat rather than resolving it).
